Dates now come out zero-padded (`2026-03-05`, not `2026-3-5`) everywhere the project formats them. `npm test` passes: 4 of 4, including the new tests.

The bug was in three files, each building the date by hand from `getUTCMonth() + 1` and `getUTCDate()` with no padding:
- `report.js`: the report header
- `email.js`: the payment reminder subject
- `export.js`: the CSV order date

I added `date.js` with a `formatDay()` helper that produces `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC. All three files now call it, so the format lives in one place. The existing report test already expected the padded form, which is why it was the one that caught the bug.

I also added `test/date.test.js`, which checks single-digit months and days through all three call sites.
